c1.code:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant C as 客户端 Client
  participant S as 服务端 Server
  Note over C,S: 传统 TCP + TLS 1.3 需要 2-RTT
  C->>S: 1. Initial [Client Hello + TLS KeyShare]
  activate S
  S-->>C: 2. Handshake [Server Hello + Finished]
  deactivate S
  Note over C: 已完成对称密钥协商，立即发送应用加密数据
  C->>S: 3. 1-RTT Application Data [HTTP/3 GET /api]
  S-->>C: 4. 1-RTT Application Data [HTTP/3 Response 200 OK]
